payload.title: route_page_statically_imported treats every import of a pages/ specifier without the type keyword as a runtime page import, so a named import used only as a type (erased by esbuild) and a side-effect stylesheet import under pages/ are reported as pages welded into the initial chunk, and the same imports shrink the lazy share that decides whether the file is a router.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.ts:119-134 (type-only means the type keyword only, and a side-effect import returns false)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.ts:161-170 (every non-type relative pages specifier becomes a static page, whatever its bindings or extension)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.ts:181-190 (the same set sizes the denominator of the 75 percent lazy share)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.tool.json:60-64 (premise 1 says a runtime, not type-only, static import of a page module)
tools/aria-adapters/bundle-budget-adapter.test.ts:156-161 (the type-only fixture pins only the import type keyword form)
web/modules/hr-module/tsconfig.json:12 (isolatedModules without verbatimModuleSyntax, so an import used only as a type compiles and is erased)
payload.rule_violated: The rule's own contract (manifest premise 1: a runtime, not type-only, static import of a page module); a detector must not report what the build erases or what is not a page.
payload.notes: In a remote's router with 20 lazy pages, import { FinancePageProps } from './pages/finance/FinancePage' used only in a type annotation, or import './pages/pages.css', is reported at its line with the message that the page is welded into the initial chunk, although the build loads neither. The 0 findings on the real repo today only show that no router carries such an import yet. The same imports also count as static pages in the share, so enough of them push a router under 75 percent lazy and it stops being checked. Close condition: Decide a page import by use and kind, not by the import keyword: count a static import as runtime only when a binding is referenced in a value position (or the specifier is a bare side-effect import of a .ts or .tsx module), and skip asset specifiers; add router fixtures for a type-used named import and a pages/*.css side-effect import that expect no finding and no change of the lazy share. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 3). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
